chunks: And the Day when We shall raise up in every nation a witness against them from among themselves, and We have brought you as a witness against these; and We have revealed to you the Book as an exposition of everything, and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.
ai.seo_question: What is the role of the Prophet and the Quran as witnesses on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'witness from among themselves' is often interpreted as the individual's own conscience or deeds, while the Prophet (SAWW) serves as the ultimate divine witness, a role that underscores the Imamate's continuity as the living proof of God. The description of the Quran as a 'Tibyanan li-kulli shay'' (exposition of all things) is pivotal in Shia scholarship, supporting the view that it contains the essential principles and details necessary for guidance, often complemented by the Ahl al-Bayt's interpretation. This verse thus links the authority of the Prophet to the comprehensiveness of the Quran, offering glad tidings specifically to those who submit to this divine structure.
